pick_rule: best 1-2 by (verdict rank, Holm p, net $): all 6 TOO FEW -> lowest Holm p: P2 (0.111), then P6 (0.316, the next lowest)

P2.name: 80% rule fast (2x5m), prior-RTH value area
P2.rules: Prior RTH day = latest earlier file within 4 days with >= 40 RTH bars; 1-pt bin footprint profile, 70% VA (POC start, add larger adjacent bin, tie above), VAH = top bin + 0.75, VAL = low bin. RTH 09:30 bar open > VAH -> short (open < VAL -> long). First two consecutive 5m bars that both CLOSE strictly inside (VAL, VAH), 2nd bar opening 09:35-12:00 ET; skip if the far edge was already traded since 09:30. Gate: delta (buy - sell) of the 2 bars x d > 0. Stop 1 tick beyond the 2 bars' extreme. Entry E5: limit at the re-entered edge (VAH short / VAL long) for the next 5m bar (open beyond -> fill at open; trades 1 tick through -> fill at the edge, stop-only that bar; stop traded first -> no fill), else market next open + 18 ticks against. Target = far VA edge, needs 1 tick through. Stop fill 2 ticks worse; flat 15:55 bar close - 2 ticks; $1.90 rt; one position at a time; book = gated.

P6.name: prior-RTH VA edge fade to the prior POC, absorption gate
P6.rules: Prior RTH profile as P2 (POC = max 1-pt bin + 0.50). Bars opening 09:45-15:00 ET: high >= VAH + 1 tick and close < VAH -> short; low <= VAL - 1 tick and close > VAL -> long; one per edge per day (first firing uses it up). Gate ABSORBED (OF1): zone = footprint within 8 ticks of the bar's pushed extreme, vz > 0, dz x d < 0, |dz| >= 0.20 x vz, bar >= 20 trades. Stop 1 tick beyond the signal bar extreme. Entry E5 with level = the edge (as P2). Target = prior RTH POC, needs 1 tick through; fill at/beyond the POC -> no trade. Stop fill 2 ticks worse; flat 15:55 bar close - 2 ticks; $1.90 rt; one position at a time (busy if decision <= booked exit bar open); book = gated.
